android.desc:
Never miss a birthday again.

Piñata is a birthday reminder app with no ads, ever. No sign-up required. No tracking. Just smart, reliable reminders for the birthdays that matter most.

🎂 BIRTHDAY REMINDERS

Choose when to be notified: on the day, one day before, three days ahead, or a full week in advance. Piñata makes sure you are always prepared without last-minute scrambling.

📇 IMPORT FROM CONTACTS AND CALENDAR

Instantly import birthdays from your address book. No manual typing needed. Already have birthdays saved in your calendar? Import those directly too.

📅 BIRTHDAY CALENDAR VIEW

See every birthday organized by month. A clean, full-year calendar so you always know what is coming up.

📝 NOTES FOR CONTACTS

Add personal notes to anyone on your list. Two notes included, unlimited with Piñata Pro.

🎨 CUSTOM PROFILES

Add photos or choose from built-in avatars for every person on your birthday tracker.

🎁 MY BIRTHDAY HUB

A dedicated space for your own birthday. Celebrity birthdays, historical events, pop culture moments, birthday stats, and more — all tied to your birth date.

🌍 6 LANGUAGES

Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Portuguese.

⭐ PIÑATA PRO — $9.99/YEAR

- 3-day and 7-day advance reminders so you have time to prepare
- Cloud backup. Switch devices, reinstall, or upgrade your phone and everything comes back instantly
- Bulk contact import
- One-tap birthday messages that auto-fill each person's name and age
- Daily horoscopes for everyone on your list
- Unlimited notes

🔒 YOUR PRIVACY

No sign-up required. No ads, ever. Piñata collects no personal data and uses no tracking. The Google Play data safety section confirms: no data shared with third parties. No data collected.

quotes.text:
Hey everyone! I'm an indie developer launching my first app on Google Play, and I need help meeting Google's requirement of 12 closed testers for 14 days before I can go to production.
What is it? Piñata is a birthday reminder app with a clean design.
What I need: Just install the app and keep it for 14 days. No active testing required, though feedback is always appreciated!
How to join:
  1. Click this link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pinata.app
  2. Opt-in on the Google Play page
  3. Download and install
I'd really appreciate the help from the community. This is a requirement for first-time app releases, and it would mean a lot to get this over the finish line.
Thanks in advance!
